title: UAE Student Visa Sponsorship & 10-Year Golden Visa Eligibility for University Graduates

runs.t: International students in the UAE generally need a valid residence status linked to their study arrangements. A university, parent or other eligible sponsor may arrange the student residence visa, depending on the student’s age, institution and emirate. A student visa is not a work permit and does not automatically convert into a Golden Visa after graduation. The Golden Residency is a separate long-term residence category with specific eligibility rules and supporting evidence.

Some high-performing graduates can qualify for a 10-year UAE Golden Residency, but the rules differ for graduates of UAE universities and graduates of overseas universities. ICP’s published criteria for graduates of international universities include a university in the recognised top 100, a minimum bachelor’s GPA of 3.5/4.0, graduation within the previous two years and UAE Ministry of Education attestation. For graduates of UAE universities, the institution must be licensed/accredited and classified A or B, with GPA thresholds of 3.5 or 3.8 respectively and graduation within two years. Eligibility is not automatic; the authority assesses the application.

sections.title: UAE student residence visa: sponsorship basics

runs.t: Student residence arrangements are generally made through the licensed university/educational institution or, in some circumstances, a parent who meets the applicable sponsorship conditions. Procedures, documentation and service channels can differ between emirates and free zones. Ask the institution’s international student office which authority processes the visa and who will act as sponsor.

rows.t: Confirm the institution is authorised to enrol international students and can sponsor or facilitate the relevant residence status.
Follow the sponsor’s instructions on entry permit, status change and deadlines. Do not travel or overstay based on informal advice.
Residence procedures for adults commonly include medical fitness screening; confirm age, category and emirate-specific requirements.
Complete the Emirates ID application and biometrics as instructed by the sponsor/ICP.
Check the emirate’s health-insurance requirement and the university’s cover. Do not assume campus insurance satisfies all residence requirements.
Track expiry dates, academic status and cancellation procedures. Ask what happens if you defer, withdraw or change institutions.

sections.title: Student visa is not an employment visa

runs.t: A Student Residence Visa permits residence for study under its conditions. It does not give an unrestricted right to work. Students considering part-time employment, internships or paid placements must confirm the applicable work permit, training permit or other authorisation with the employer and relevant UAE labour/immigration authority. Do not rely on an institution’s general statement about internships without checking the individual arrangement.

The UAE Golden Residency is a long-term residence category that can allow eligible people to live, work, study and invest without the usual employer or family sponsor. It is available through several categories, including investors, entrepreneurs, exceptional talents and outstanding students/graduates. A 10-year validity period applies to the relevant eligible categories, subject to approval and continuing conditions.

sections.title: Golden Visa eligibility for graduates of UAE universities

head.t: Published ICP criteria for UAE university graduates

rows.t: Bachelor’s, Master’s or Doctorate from a university licensed/accredited by the UAE Ministry of Education.
University classified as Category A or Category B under the approved classification.
At least 3.5/4.0 for Category A; at least 3.8/4.0 for Category B.
No more than two years before the application date.
Academic qualification must be attested by the Ministry of Education.
Valid UAE health insurance and valid passport; follow the relevant ICP/emirate application requirements.

sections.title: Golden Visa eligibility for graduates of international universities

head.t: Published ICP criteria for international university graduates

rows.t: Bachelor’s degree from an international university.
University among the top 100 globally according to the international ranking recognised by the UAE Ministry of Education.
No more than two years before the application date.
Academic qualification must be attested by the UAE Ministry of Education; check the current recognition/equivalency process.
The published ICP criteria specify a bachelor’s degree for this international-university graduate route; do not assume a foreign Master’s alone meets it.
Graduate of UAE university – Category A
Graduate of UAE university – Category B
Top 100 under ranking recognised by UAE MoHESR
Within 2 years; bachelor’s route stated by ICP

runs.t: The matrix is a screening guide, not an approval decision. The recognised ranking list, institutional category, GPA equivalence and attestation are determined under the current UAE authority rules. Do not calculate eligibility from QS/THE rankings alone without checking the ranking source accepted by MoHESR.
Identify the correct Golden Residency category and competent authority (ICP or the relevant emirate authority such as GDRFA).
Check the latest eligibility criteria and whether a nomination/recommendation is required for the selected category.
Prepare passport, photograph, degree certificate, official transcript showing final GPA, attestation/recognition documents and health insurance evidence.
Submit through the official ICP or emirate portal and pay the published fees.
Respond to requests for additional documents and wait for the authority’s decision before making relocation or employment assumptions.

ICP’s service card for graduates of accredited UAE universities lists an application fee of AED 100, issuance fee of AED 100 and smart services fee of AED 100. Fees and service routes can change; check the live service card before applying. The service card also specifies passport validity of at least six months and valid UAE health insurance.

sections.title: Does a Golden Visa mean tax-free salary and guaranteed PR?

runs.t: The UAE does not generally levy personal income tax on an individual’s employment salary under the current federal personal income tax framework, but this should not be simplified into a promise that every form of income is tax-free in every country. Tax residency, overseas income, business income, corporate tax and home-country obligations can still matter. A Golden Residency is a long-term UAE residence permit, not citizenship or an automatic right to permanent settlement in another country.

sections.title: What if a graduate does not qualify for the Golden Visa?

runs.t: A graduate may still be able to remain in the UAE through an employer-sponsored work residence route or another eligible residence category. The employer and authority must assess the correct route. Do not describe the Golden Visa as the only post-study option, and do not imply that graduation alone gives a graduate an automatic grace period or work right.

faq.q: Can every international graduate from a UAE university get a 10-year Golden Visa?

runs.t: No. The published ICP route requires an eligible UAE university classification, GPA threshold, graduation within two years, degree attestation and other conditions.

faq.q: Can an Indian graduate from a top-100 university in India qualify?

runs.t: Potentially, under the international-university graduate route if the university is in the top 100 recognised by UAE MoHESR, the applicant has at least 3.5 GPA, graduated within two years, holds a qualifying bachelor’s degree and completes attestation and other requirements.

faq.q: Does a Master’s degree from a foreign university qualify under the international graduate category?

runs.t: The ICP page’s international-university graduate criteria specify a bachelor’s degree. Do not assume a foreign Master’s alone qualifies under this particular category.

faq.q: Does a student visa allow part-time work in Dubai?

runs.t: Not automatically. Students must check the required work/training authorisation and the applicable labour and immigration rules before starting work.

faq.q: Is Golden Visa the same as permanent residency or citizenship?

runs.t: No. It is a long-term residence category with its own validity and renewal rules; it is not UAE citizenship.
